high_level_description: The image depicts a person taking a selfie on a beach during what appears to be early morning or late evening, as the sky is overcast with a soft, diffused light. The individual is wearing a dark-colored hoodie with a Nike logo on the left chest area and has long hair tied back. They are also wearing black headphones around their neck. The background features a sandy beach with gentle waves lapping at the shore. The ocean extends into the horizon, meeting the sky where it fades into a pale blue. There are no other people visible in the image, giving it a solitary and peaceful atmosphere.
